Upstream stable is 1.4.12; the candidate stays 1.1.20 because 1.4.12 is not yet captured into Surface. OpenCode 2.x (@opencode/cli, tags v2.0.0-v2.2.5) is a separate protocol family: no `attach`, a `/api/*` HttpApi with sequenced v2 events, and different npm packages. The github-stable detector reports it because v2 releases are non-prerelease, while acquisition covers only the 1.x opencode-<platform> packages; draft/OPENCODE-2-MIGRATION-PLAN.md records the unstarted migration.
